dogecoin.text:
I’ll never forget when we thought $9 per Bitcoin was insanely high.

Everyone said “you think it’s too late to get in?” And “oh it’ll go to nothing” 

Dogecoin - Learn lessons from those bitcoin and early Etherium experiences. It could go to zero... it could also hit $100.
Can’t express how awesome this Dogecoin growth is for so many good people whose lives are about to change.

It was #2. Doge to the moon. 

What I love is Elon is the world's richest man. He has no need to do this, but I believe he genuinely knows exactly how young (and old) Dogecoin dreamers' lives will be changed for the better when it breaks $1, then $5, the $100.

@chrisstanchak OH Dogecoin hodl’ers are up 20,000% this year. 

Knowing from a friend.

It is my uneducated guess (after 10 years toying with crypto) that Dogecoin and Shiba will have epic 10x breakouts in the coming months. Etherium will shoot past $10k peaking and settling somewhere near 15-19k. Bitcoin will break 75k.
